prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Premium brand illustration for the AI section below the hero of the Promo Group website.
Primary request: Create one expressive unified abstract sculpture: several crystal-clear translucent glass planes collect many fine orange streams into one strong, clear ascending orange stream. The visual metaphor is AI gathering data and discovering business growth, expressed as a beautiful physical sculpture, not a diagram.
Scene/backdrop: Seamless very light warm ivory studio background, close to #fff6ef. Minimal refined composition.
Composition/framing: Landscape 4:3 composition, ideally 1536x1152. Entire sculpture fully visible and centered slightly to the right, occupying center and right half. Quiet empty space on left. No cropping of sculpture. Three-quarter studio camera angle with a little depth.
Style/medium: Exceptionally polished photorealistic high-end 3D still life. Tactile matte porcelain foundations and translucent orange optical glass. Delicate caustics and restrained shadows. A few clear vertical planes delicately staggered in depth, slender orange glass filaments flowing through them and joining into one elegant ascending strand, seamless sculptural continuity.
Lighting/mood: Soft warm studio light, airy, intelligent, calm, precise; orange is the brightest color but never neon.
Color palette: White and warm ivory #fff6ef; hot orange #ff8331 and restrained red-orange #eb4a3f highlights; subtle warm graphite only for small shadows.
Text: No text of any kind.
Constraints: One cohesive sculptural object, not a collection of disconnected props. No computer, dashboards, charts, icons, arrows, robot, face, brain, microchip, purple, blue, neon, glow effects, typography, labels, logos, watermark. Do not turn it into a technical schematic or infographic.
